name: Ennoia: Metamorphosis
source:
Within the snowy plains of the kingdom of Solstice, a girl enrolls in one of their finest magic academies— One of the most prestigious, in fact. Many verified scholars highly regard it as having some of the best magical education across the kingdom. Yet, a strange occurrence had come into play.

Whispers began to spread about the sudden disappearances of female students. From weeks to days, once an established academia with little to no rumors, now had gossip that's reached the ears of the alumni. Alerted, the heiress to the throne took notice— So she bestows her trust on an old friend to investigate. 
 
—A budding alchemist trying to make ends meet.

[From [url=https://x0ver-time.itch.io/ennoiam]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在至日王国（Solstice）白雪皑皑的平原深处，一名少女考入了全国最顶尖、最负盛名的魔法学院之一。众多权威学者都对其推崇备至，盛赞这里拥有整个王国首屈一指的魔法教育。然而，一桩离奇异变悄然浮出水面。

关于女学生接连无故失踪的窃窃私语开始在校园内蔓延。从数周一起到数日一起，这所昔日几乎毫无风言风语的名门学府，如今流言甚至传到了历届校友耳中。王位继承人闻讯警觉，遂将信任托付给了一位老友前去暗中彻查——

——一位正勉强糊口度日的新晋炼金术士。

[摘自[url=https://x0ver-time.itch.io/ennoiam]itch.io[/url]]
